reason: The cited evidence confirms BCS-type superconductivity and an isotropic s-wave gap in related bcc HEAs (E4), but none of the passages directly support the mechanistic link between high configurational entropy and uniform electron–phonon coupling, nor the predicted insensitivity of Tc to compositional fluctuations. The key causal premises are therefore largely unsupported by the provided evidence.
premises: High configurational entropy stabilizes uniform bonding environments in bcc HEAs
Uniform bonding preserves robust, isotropic electron–phonon coupling
This results in an isotropic s-wave superconducting gap
Tc is largely insensitive to moderate local compositional fluctuations
Reducing configurational entropy broadens the transition and lowers Tc
